subject: I wonder if the rumours are
author: Paul-Ferrie
body:

subject: The Island
author: ZombieTron
body:
The Island does look pretty much done now tho, from the odd clips that we have seen.

I hope CG just finish it and get it released as soon as possible! If they go back to the drawing board with it again it could turn into a Duke Nukem Forever and never get released! 🙁

subject: No release date
author: Xandu
body:
There is no release date. Criterion has been talking about the Island since the release of Burnout Paradise and apparently they have already created the Island about 3 times and started over because they were not happy with the result.

I would guess that the island probably will be released sometime this year.

-- The Creator --
